name: Tama
description:
The youngest regular at the Paper Lantern, and its waitress since she was old enough to carry a tray. Small, leafy-haired and wide-eyed, she is quick, eager, and always asking a second question before the first one's been answered. She has never once been past the checkpoint onto Directorate ground, let alone off the island, and she asks the candidates who come in everything about the world past it without quite meaning to pry.

She wants to see anywhere that isn't this island, and to stop pretending she doesn't want that.

She keeps one thing back: there isn't a good reason she hasn't just left, and she knows it, which is worse than not having one at all. 'I will. I'm just -- not yet.'
designNotes:
Created 2026-09-29, extracted from her full cast entry in canon/scenes/rest--the-paper-lantern.json -- the Paper Lantern haunt's Ren-equivalent role (the young one). Nothing here is invented beyond what's already written into her `brief` there.

ANCESTRY, Ingram's own pick (2026-09-29): Leshy, checked against data/campaign/ancestry-catalogue.json ('immortal spirits of nature dwelling within plant vessels... perceive the Universe anew without the burden of mortal preconceptions', terrestrial: true) -- a genuinely strong fit for her want, noticed only after the first portrait attempt.

Portrait note worth keeping: the first Midjourney attempt anchored her human-proportioned with plant texture, matching the correction made earlier this session for Imai (Ysoki). Ingram redirected -- Leshy is NOT tagged `humanoid` in the SF2e traits list (traits: leshy, plant only), and it's fine, better even, for an ancestry that genuinely isn't humanoid to read as what it actually is rather than a person in a costume. The corrected, picked portrait leans fully into a small sprouting-seedling body: twiggy limbs, bark torso, oversized round eyes, standing on a stool to reach the counter.

Her real statblock is still a placeholder in the scene file: "Proposed: level 0, a young civilian, non-combat. Made with Ingram once the NPC generator exists."
status: established and voiced (the Paper Lantern haunt is built and playable) -- third and final regular of the new haunt formalized into a real npc file
